# algolia_rule (Resource)

Manages an Algolia Rule for a specific index.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "algolia_index" "example" {
  name                = "products"
  deletion_protection = false
}

# A merchandising rule: when a query contains a brand facet, boost results
# matching the "featured" query.
resource "algolia_rule" "example" {
  index_name  = algolia_index.example.name
  object_id   = "featured-brand"
  description = "Boost featured brand searches"

  conditions {
    pattern   = "{facet:brand}"
    anchoring = "contains"
  }

  consequence {
    params_json = jsonencode({
      query = "featured"
    })
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `index_name` (String) The index that owns the rule.
- `object_id` (String) Unique identifier of the rule.

### Optional

- `conditions` (Block List) Conditions that trigger the rule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--conditions))
- `consequence` (Block List) Rule consequence definition. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--consequence))
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the rule.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is active.
- `validity` (Block List) Time windows during which the rule is active. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--validity))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform identifier in the form <index_name>/<object_id>.

<a id="nestedblock--conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `conditions`

Optional:

- `alternatives` (Boolean) Whether plurals, synonyms, and typos should match.
- `anchoring` (String) How the pattern is matched.
- `context` (String) Optional rule context restriction.
- `filters` (String) Optional facet filter expression.
- `pattern` (String) Literal pattern or {facet:attribute} matcher.


<a id="nestedblock--consequence"></a>
### Nested Schema for `consequence`

Optional:

- `hide` (Set of String) Object IDs to hide.
- `params_json` (String) JSON-encoded consequence params object.
- `promote` (Block List) Promoted object IDs and their position. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--consequence--promote))
- `user_data` (String) JSON-encoded userData payload appended to search responses.

<a id="nestedblock--consequence--promote"></a>
### Nested Schema for `consequence.promote`

Required:

- `object_ids` (Set of String) Object IDs to promote as a group.
- `position` (Number) Result position for the promoted group.



<a id="nestedblock--validity"></a>
### Nested Schema for `validity`

Optional:

- `from` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the rule becomes active.
- `until` (String) RFC3339 timestamp when the rule stops being active.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Import a rule using the form "index_name/object_id".
terraform import algolia_rule.example products/featured-brand
```
